For representation permutation R and index permutation I, logical-to-canonical p=I.map o R.map, canonical-to-logical p^-1=R.inv o I.inv. PartialStructure::logical_slots returns C[p(i)], while from_logical_slots constructs the canonical carrier retaining that inverse. Thus these operations are coordinate changes, not an assumption that source strings already have native canonical order.

NumeratorInterface::admit explicitly parses these full named slot declarations and passes their order through from_logical_slots/from_declared_parts. Inference validates compatible tensor interfaces. export computes logical ports with the layout inverse; absent declarations mean its source re-admission check recovered that logical list, and present declarations carry the actual list. canonical_ports orders decoded source notation through an explicit permutation. No equality between native sort order, decoded lexical order and historical left/right survivor order is assumed.

Current interface_is_named checks explicit indices and absence of internal open-port markers. index_has_open_port treats these ordinary function-valued hedge/edge labels as named; complete tags and reversible-payload association remain the accepted exact P3 premise. Representation::matches requires exact dimensions, selfdual equality or opposite cof duality. The finite parser checks precisely this domain, not arbitrary index notation.

ProductPlan::named rejects ambiguous partners. free_interface removes those logical endpoints via the same inverse and canonically orders survivors. The actual native canonical permutation need not be guessed: it appears together with its inverse before any logical pair is consumed.
